policy.mode_selection_contract: A future FN_DEPENDENCY_MODE=system|vendored option must select one complete dependency source without network fallback. The default remains system.

libraries.name: libev
libraries.reason: V0.1 uses the libev API, but the requested GitHub repository presents itself as a mirror and is not the upstream distribution location recorded by the project. Keep the verified Debian package until an authoritative, maintained Git source and exact revision are approved.

libraries.name: libyaml
libraries.reason: P03 uses the public libyaml event parser API. The requested repository is the canonical source repository; a vendored mode may pin the reviewed 0.2.5 revision.

libraries.name: json-parser
libraries.reason: V0.1 does not accept JSON configuration. Machine-readable output can be emitted without a JSON DOM parser.

libraries.name: uthash
libraries.reason: No current V0.1 component requires the uthash macro API; bounded project-owned arrays and indexes are sufficient for the implemented contracts.

libraries.name: xxHash
libraries.reason: A fast non-cryptographic hash may be evaluated for later Geo/index formats, but V0.1 has no accepted consumer or file-format contract for it.

libraries.name: c-ares
libraries.reason: V0.1 has a project-specific bounded resolver contract and does not link c-ares. Its source is reviewed for parsing and resolver behavior only.

libraries.name: lwIP
libraries.reason: lwIP belongs to a possible future TUN/user-space TCP-IP stack and is outside the native Linux V0.1 scope. The requested GitHub repository is also a mirror of the Savannah source.
